scope: Prescribed-render held-out FastWAM contrast on tasks passing both native and development checks
status: Analysis specification recorded after the native closed-loop diagnostic and before held-out transplant outcomes
unit: One initial state with both seeds eligible and both unedited encoding controls passed
estimand: Half-difference between positive-x and negative-x gripper endpoints under target translation minus the corresponding half-difference under distractor translation
margin_basis: Engineering tolerance equal to one sixth of the prescribed 3 cm object translation; the previous native VAE round-trip pilot drift was approximately 1-2 mm. This is an engineering interpretation, not a learned perceptual threshold.
grouping: Average two seeds within state, then report by task with state-block bootstrap intervals. Keep all failed manipulation, sham and alternate native checks in denominators.
criteria: Report the signed target, nuisance and difference estimates separately. Treat an interval entirely within +/-5 mm as conditional evidence of limited nuisance sensitivity. A near-zero selective contrast alone cannot distinguish insensitivity to both from sensitivity to both.
alternate_prompt: A different official-style instruction for the distractor has a separate native first-contact and unedited-sham check. Only valid instruction pairs support a crossover interpretation.
